title: StitchScope Vision Proposal (identification only)
description: The structured shape a vision-model PHOTO call must conform to. v3, not v2: the photo call now only IDENTIFIES stitch regions (region_label, stitch_family, confidence, uncertain_fields) -- it no longer proposes any row structure. A photo-grounded call kept inventing garment-specific numbers (oversized setup chains, inconsistent turning chains) when asked to propose row structure from an image, but the same model gives correct, standard answers when asked generically how a named stitch is conventionally constructed, with no image involved. See stitch_recipe_schema_v1.json and engine/vision.py's get_stitch_recipe() for that separate, non-photo call. proposal_schema_v2.json is kept around, marked superseded, as a record of that change. engine/schema.py enforces these same rules in plain Python.

photo_id.description: Optional label for the source photo/crop this proposal came from.

regions.description: One entry per distinct stitch pattern detected in the photo.

region_label.description: Where this stitch pattern is on the garment, e.g. 'center panel' or 'fan panel (left)'.

stitch_family.description: Human-readable name for the guessed stitch pattern, e.g. 'filet mesh'. This is the ONLY thing used to look up or ask how it's constructed -- see engine/vision.py's get_stitch_recipe().

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in this region's identification, 0-1. Metadata about the guess, not validated for correctness.

uncertain_fields.description: Names of fields the model is unsure about for this region, e.g. 'stitch_family'. Empty list means confident in everything proposed for this region.
